title: noise.henon_heilles
description: `noise.henon_heilles` implements the Hénon–Heiles system as a port of Richard Dudas’s chaos collection object, providing x, y, xdot, and ydot values through four outlets. Send it a bang (for example, from `metro`) to output values; its state and parameters can be controlled with x, y, y', e, dt, set, and reset messages.
